choices.reason: The three candidates use the same unadjusted, participant-level outcome summaries from one session, and no primary or main pairwise contrast for unique proposals is identified. No remaining rule resolves the tie: the study varies control within an agentic system, has no shared no-AI control or combined-arm contrast, and has no repeated-session, subgroup, factorial, or after-AI distinction.

choices.quote: We further differentiate these controls into three human supervised levels: Low, Medium, and Intensive. [...] For metrics available under all conditions, we conducted a one-way ANOVA followed by Tukey’s HSD post-hoc analysis when the ANOVA showed significance.
